newsitem.title: UK: J.P. Morgan leads equity collateralised FRN.
newsitem.headline: J.P. Morgan leads equity collateralised FRN.

text.p: The Strategic Money Management Company (S.M.M.) BV has issued a six-tranche multi-currency FRN collateralised by an equity portfolio, lead manager J.P. Morgan said in a statement on Thursday.
The tranches are $120 million, 160 million marks, 60 million guilders, 127 million Swiss francs, 37 million stg and C$27 million.
The issue price for all tranches is par. Tranches pay three month Libor +6.25 b.p. except the C$27 million tranche which pays three month CAD-BA-CDOR +6.25 b.p.
The bonds will mature on May 21, 1999, there are no fees and listing will be in Luxembourg.
There are U.S. U.K. and Netherlands sales limits, denoms are 10,000, there is New York law, no negative pledge, no cross default and force majeure IPMA 1.
